title: One Request Absorbs Three Quarters of Kazakh Spare Warehousing
subtitle: Wildberries began searching for a single Class A facility of 100,000 square metres in a country with only about 130,000 square metres of high-grade vacancy in total.

source.name: Kazakh commercial property market data and Wildberries facility search reporting

data.label: All vacant Class A space, Kazakhstan
Single facility sought
data.annotation: One tenant, one building, in a market that cannot supply it.

measure.axisTitle: Square metres of Class A space

supportingFacts.label: The search comes on top of two facilities the company is already taking in Kazakhstan's two largest cities.
Taking most of the national vacancy would price out Kazakh retailers seeking the same buildings.

metadata.keyFinding: A single Wildberries requirement equals 77% of all vacant Class A space in Kazakhstan.
